about_the_game:
Welcome to Snap & Print! 📸

Run the cutest little photo & print shop in town, where every day brings a new and charming challenge. Customers arrive with unique requests — from magical pet portraits to restoring treasured family photos, and it’s your job to bring their visions to life.

✨ What You’ll Do

  • Take portraits – Snap ID photos, themed shoots, pet pics, and more.
  • Get creative – Add hats, flowers, stickers, backgrounds, and props to match your client’s style.
  • Edit & restore – Remove scratches, colorize old photos, apply filters, and fix imperfections.
  • Print & scan – Make copies, cut to size, and handle important documents.
  • Play cozy mini-games – From photo retouching to perfect paper cuts.

🏆 Progress & Upgrade

Earn money and reviews from happy customers to upgrade your studio. Unlock:
  • New props and stickers
  • Fun photo filters and frames
  • Bigger paper sizes and better printers

🎨 A Cozy Creative Space

Snap & Print blends the joy of creativity with the charm of running your own little shop. With drag-and-drop tools, gentle animations, and satisfying sounds, every session feels relaxing and rewarding.

💌 Wishlist Now!

Help us get the word out and be the first to know when Snap & Print launches, add it to your wishlist today!

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 12.04, SteamOS (Proton-8 Recommended)
  • Processor: 1.7 GHz Processor
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 8 or higher, ATI X1600 or higher, or Intel HD 3000 or higher
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: OpenAL Compatible Sound Card
  • Additional Notes: Proton-8 Recommended

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Mac OS X 10.6 or above
  • Processor: Apple Silicon M1 (M2 and M3) or Intel Core M
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 1280x720 minimum resolution, OpenGL 2.0 Support, and recommended dedicated graphics card with 128 MB of RAM
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: OpenAL Compatible Sound Card
  • Additional Notes: M1, M2, M3 Silicon Mac & ARM Supported
